events.description: A man in dark clothing engages in physical combat with another person: pigeons scatter (f5), a flash of smoke/gas appears near the man’s hand (f6), he is struck and thrown backward (f7–f8), stumbles (f11–f12), falls upside-down (f13), and is later seen on the ground while the opponent moves away (f15–f16).

verification.reason: Multiple frames show reciprocal physical contact, loss of balance, and dynamic motion consistent with mutual combat; no evidence of one-sided helplessness or weapon discharge.

events.description: At f6 (18.5 s), a visible muzzle flash and smoke plume emanate from the man’s right hand as he extends his arm forward; at f7 (19.0 s), the same man recoils with arms outstretched, consistent with recoil and follow-through of a firearm discharge.

verification.reason: The bright conical flash and expanding smoke at f6 are characteristic of a gunshot; the posture change at f7 supports recoil. No other explanation fits the visual evidence.
